equations.balance: saved_j, bits; starts at 0 (getattr default) for every stream; never reset during a life
equations.credit (historical, grownet.py:799-801): at each accepted (vouched) taste, after every stream's learn call in that taste, for each stream j that spoke at taste time: saved_j += log2(q_j(y) / p_def(y)), q_j its speaker's KT probability for the revealed letter y computed just before its own learn call (so after earlier streams' learning in the same taste), p_def(y) the default's KT probability; can be negative; units bits
equations.credit (D82 issued contract, issued_cred: same increment but q_j(y) from the forecast issued at the last prediction before the taste, applied at the next prediction
equations.debit: none: a transfer does not reduce saved_j; the price is a threshold that rises with the units held
equations.price test, design market (grownet.py:17: saved_j > POOL_BITS * (len(units_j) - base_j + 1), base_j = allowance at birth (grownet.py:467), POOL_BITS = 1 bit (grownet.py:71); evaluated only when len(units_j) >= P_j
equations.donor test, design market (grownet.py:17: some other stream v with saved_v <= 0 and P_v > 3
equations.price test, lab rule M (alloc_rules.py:9: the same threshold, and a birth due (deep firing unit has seen both labels)
equations.donor test, lab rule M (alloc_rules.py:9: some other stream v with saved_v <= 0 and P_v > fixed units of v
equations.transfer: donor's least used of 4 sampled leaves recycled, P_v -= 1, P_j += 1
equations.timing: the room test runs inside stream j's learn call (grownet.py:260, called at :761) during the taste loop; the credit for that taste is added after the loop (historical) or at the next prediction (D82): a taste's saving can first fund room at the next taste
equations.design allowance: P_j = max(3, P // 168) (grownet.py:455): 3 for every stream at P=560, 26 at P=4480
